items.title: Bloom Surges After Raising Guidance as Earnings Double Estimates
items.summary: Bloom Energy Corp. jumped after the fuel-cell maker posted earnings that were more than double expectations and raised full-year guidance for the second consecutive quarter, a sign of rampant demand from data centers.

items.title: Koch Said to Mull $15 Billion Sale of Data-Center Firm Edged
items.summary: Koch Inc. is exploring a sale of Edged, the data center developer it cofounded to build projects for the biggest hyperscalers, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
